title: The Awkward silence at table
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：awkward　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 awkward 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the headmaster wrote of ① an awkward silence at table in the record, and everybody in the school said at once that it was ② more awkward than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the headmaster, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the awkward ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most awkward silence at table anybody in the school had ever seen, or so the record for October 1975 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too awkward to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the awkward ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an awkward boy with a pen, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as awkward as the boy with a pen they had once had in the old school. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was awkward or not, and he said so.

By 1988 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something awkward, and nothing besides. The student from the next school called the whole plan ⑧ quite awkward; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the awkward ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1991, with great care, she wrote of another awkward silence at table in the same record, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more awkward than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most awkward boy with a pen in the whole school, she said in 1993, was the one she could never quite name; the awkward ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 尴尬（前置定语 an awkward silence at table：1981 年校长在学籍册里记下的那件尴尬的沉默）
B. adj. 尴尬／笨拙（比较级 more awkward than：文中两处，一处比饭桌上的沉默，一处比预想）
C. adj. 尴尬／笨拙（最高级 the most awkward：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 尴尬（表语 too awkward to do：母亲觉得它太尴尬，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 笨拙（前置定语 an awkward boy with a pen：叔叔把整件事称作一桩笨拙的少年）
F. adj. 笨拙（同级比较 as awkward as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩握笔的少年相比）
G. adj. 笨拙（后置定语 something awkward：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 笨拙（受程度副词修饰 quite awkward：那位学生的评价）

items.q: the most awkward silence at table anybody
an awkward boy with a pen
The most awkward boy with a pen in

answers.why: awkward 意为“尴尬”，1981 年校长在学籍册里记下的是“一件尴尬的沉默”，此处作前置定语 an awkward silence at table。
awkward 意为“尴尬”，此处用比较级 more awkward than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
awkward 意为“尴尬”，学籍册上 十月 那行字说它是学堂里最尴尬的一件，故用最高级 the most awkward silence at table。
awkward 意为“尴尬”，母亲认为这件东西“太尴尬了，谁也用不上”，too awkward to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
awkward 意为“笨拙”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩笨拙的少年”，此处作前置定语 an awkward boy with a pen。
awkward 意为“笨拙”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩握笔的少年一样笨拙”，同级比较用 as awkward as。
awkward 意为“笨拙”，学籍册上那半行字要的是“笨拙的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something awkward。
awkward 意为“笨拙”，邻学堂来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当笨拙”，quite 修饰原级 awkward。
awkward 意为“笨拙”，1991 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要笨拙”，故用比较级 more awkward than。
awkward 意为“笨拙”，母亲 1993 年说的是“整个学堂里最笨拙的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most awkward boy with a pen。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1981 年，校长在学籍册里记下了一件尴尬的沉默。（an awkward silence at table）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更尴尬。（more awkward than …）
母亲觉得它太尴尬，谁也用不上。（too awkward to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩笨拙的少年。（an awkward boy with a pen）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩握笔的少年一样笨拙。（as awkward as …）
到了 1988 年，学籍册上只剩半行字：要的是一件笨拙的东西。（something awkward）
answers: In 1981 the headmaster wrote of an awkward silence at table in the record.
Everybody said it was more awkward than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too awkward to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an awkward boy with a pen.
He said nobody would call it as awkward as the boy with a pen they had once had.
By 1988 the record asked for nothing but something awkward.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 awkward 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the headmaster wrote of an awkward silence at table in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most awkward silence at table in the school, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too awkward to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an awkward boy with a pen, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next school called the plan quite awkward, and everybody laughed.
The awkward ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
